outputs.explanation: Panel A shows representative super-resolution micrograph reconstructions (localizations, density map, 3D localizations, cluster segmentation) for CtpG-mEos; it is not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B shows representative super-resolution micrograph reconstructions for PacL2-mEos, analogous to panel A; not a plot of averages.
Scatter/dot plot of number of clusters per cell shows mean ± SEM with individual gray dots for each cell overlaid.
Scatter/dot plot of cluster sizes shows mean ± SEM with individual gray dots for each cluster overlaid.
Scatter/dot plot of proportion of clustered molecules per cell shows mean ± SEM with individual gray dots for each cell overlaid.
Panel F shows representative sptPALM micrographs (localizations and trajectories); not a plot of averaged data.

Top is a histogram of diffusion coefficients (distribution, not a mean requiring overlay of individual points) and bottom is a line plot of mean square displacement trajectories; both plot types are exempt from requiring individual point overlays.
Panel H shows trajectory maps and a kymograph (micrograph-type reconstructions), not a plot of averaged data requiring individual points.
